name: Tokitama! ~Toki Hako Tamatebako~
source:
Toki-Hako -Time Capsule-'s "Variety disk".

Includes several mini-games and new short scenarios: 
1. Kotodama (ことだま)
2. Kashi-Hako ~Logical Valentine~(菓子函 ～ロジカル・バレンタイン～) - Logic quiz ADV with multiple endings.
3. Kara Bako -Typing Karaoke- Limited Edition (空函 -Typing Karaoke- 限定版) - Typing Karaoke ADV
4. Datsui Black Jack (脱衣ブラックジャック) - Black Jack on undressing
5. Kachinuki Shinkei Suijaku (勝ち抜き神経衰弱)
6. Niji Illustration Corner (二次イラストコーナー)
and others
